text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>... You

truly are as great as they come. I can't
help but
stand in awe.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I understand your frustration, Meek. I
really do.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But Trainer
<username>, you

and your trainee... You've both really
inspired us!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
I'll shine just as bright someday. You'll
see.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer
<username>, my
role
model and my rival...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We learned so much from them, didn't
we, Meek? Trainer
<username> really is

something else.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Yeah, and my rival racer was just as cool.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
True, but don't forget how incredible
you were out there. Watching how your
running has improved... I've really come
to believe that the
sky's the limit.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I've cooked up some new strategies for
us, so I'll be sure to run them by Trainer
 <username> later to
refine
them.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I'll try even harder.
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I should be thanking you, Meek. Let's
keep
aiming for even greater heights
together!
